item.title: Welcome Invictus Strategic Solutions, our first Founding Partner
item.description:
We're pleased to welcome Invictus Strategic Solutions as the first Founding Partner of Hostile Environment Jobs.
Invictus is a veteran-owned training and consultancy company in Oxfordshire. Its instructors come from specialist military, law enforcement, security and frontline pre-hospital care backgrounds.
2027 courses: • Qualsafe FREC 3: 11-15 Jan, 8-12 Mar, 26-30 Apr, 7-11 Jun (£495) • FREC 3 requalification: 19-21 Jan, 9-11 Feb, 20-22 Apr (£295) • Residential HEAT, Fire Service College: 23-25 Mar (£1,350 incl. accommodation)
Our members get 5% off, and you can request a booking straight from their page: https://hostileenvironmentjobs.com/employers/invictus-strategic-solutions/
Thanks to Alex and the team for backing the site early. #FREC3 #HEAT #Training #Veterans
